title: What Matters in On-Policy Distillation? A Perspective on Data Efficiency and Data Selection
abstract: arXiv:2609.05198v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) has emerged as a widely adopted post-training paradigm for enhancing large language models in reasoning domains. However, the data-centric mechanisms in OPD remain relatively underexplored. This paper presents a empirical study of data efficiency and data selection in OPD. We begin by investigating an extreme setting: training OPD on only one example, namely 1-shot OPD. Surprisingly, we find that 1-shot OPD is consistently effective across all sampled training examples and harder examples often yield superior performance gain. We next investigate what actually drives the student model's improvement in the training data. Our analysis reveals that the improvement is not driven by high token entropy, but the longer CoT paths which hard problems naturally generate. Training on longer CoT can help maintain closer alignment with the teacher over a long reasoning horizon, and learn critical thinking patterns usually

translated_title: 《在线策略蒸馏中什么最重要？从数据效率与数据选择的视角》
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏已成为一种被广泛采用的后训练范式，用于增强大语言模型在推理领域的能力。然而，OPD中以数据为中心的机制仍相对缺乏研究。本文对OPD中的数据效率与数据选择进行了实证研究。我们首先探究了一个极端设置：仅在单个样本上训练OPD，即1-shot OPD。令人惊讶的是，我们发现1-shot OPD在所有采样的训练样本上都能持续有效，且更难的样本往往能带来更显著的性能提升。接下来，我们研究了训练数据中真正驱动学生模型改进的因素。我们的分析表明，这种改进并非由高token熵驱动，而是由难题自然生成的更长的思维链路径所驱动。在更长的CoT上训练有助于在长推理过程中与教师模型保持更紧密的对齐，并学习通常……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过1-shot OPD这一极端实验发现，单样本训练即可持续有效提升模型推理能力，且难题效果更佳，其关键驱动因素是难题自然生成的更长思维链路径而非高token熵。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically shows that 1-shot On-Policy Distillation is consistently effective across all training examples, with harder examples yielding greater gains, and reveals that the improvement is driven by longer CoT paths naturally generated by hard problems rather than high token entropy.
